verdict.rationale: Docs claim an 'open source version of RudderStack' (rudderstack-docs-20/32) dependent only on PostgreSQL, but community threads document that RudderStack moved away from a permissive/AGPLv3 license to the Elastic License (a source-available, not OSI-approved open license) specifically to block competitors like Hightouch from reusing the code, contradicting the 'open license' framing. Missing for 10: clear evidence of which specific license currently governs the source, and confirmation whether it meets standard open-source definitions (freedom to modify/redistribute commercially).
